name: h_rangeBlueOrangeSwitch
note: This is specifically for shooting a switch from behind a set of blue/orange pegs.

name: h_greatFairyFreeUpgrades
note: Represents having to throw a specific item into one of the Great Fairy pools in order to receive a reward.
In the vanilla game, it is required to have the Blue Boomerang to upgrade to the Red Boomerang;
in randomizers, it will typically be the case that the Great Fairies that give items won't require throwing specific items into the pool to receive a reward.

name: h_SahasrahlasRequest
note: In the vanilla game Sahasrahla gives link a reward for having the Green Pendant.
Randomizers may be interested in changing this requirement to requiring any pendant or no pendant.

name: h_NoAgahnimLoophole
note: This helper can be used in places where traversal is free unless Agahnim is defeated, but if you had the ability to defeat Agahnim,
i.e. sword or sufficient skill to kill Agahnim with swordless methods, then traversal is also free.
devNote: Typically would only apply to places where there are no enemies unless Agahnim is defeated.
So, this is a way to avoid canRiskPermanentLossOfAccess while still making traversal free.

name: h_MothulaVulnerableToGoldSword
note: In the vanilla game, Mothula is invulnerable to the gold sword, but vulnerable to all others.
Most randomizers would want to fix this, as it could create a canRiskPermanentLossOfAccess situation.
devNote: The requires of this helper should all be removed if Mothula takes damage to the gold sword.
